name: ai-rag-project
architecture: Neural Orchestra v5 Contract-First Vertical Slicing
description: Pipeline for Artificial Intelligence, LLM, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) applications.

phases.name: AI Contract Lock & Evaluation Criteria
phases.instructions: Lock executable TypeScript contracts for LLM payloads, tool schemas, and retrieval responses. Define evaluation accuracy thresholds.

phases.name: Parallel AI & Fullstack Execution
phases.instructions: ai-rag-engineer builds chunking, vector indexing & RAG pipelines; fullstack-backend-engineer implements streaming endpoints; fullstack-frontend-engineer builds generative UI; data-platform-engineer sets up pgvector/vector store. All engineers run node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs locally.

phases.name: Zero-Token Deterministic Quality Gate
phases.instructions: Execute node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs. Map failures via orchestra-state.mjs and dispatch back if needed (max 3 retries).

phases.name: AI Evaluation, Retrieval Benchmarks & Security Audit
phases.instructions: Evaluate retrieval recall/precision, benchmark hallucination rates, test prompt injection defenses, and audit git diff.

phases.name: Production Deployment & Observability
phases.instructions: Containerize AI application, configure token tracing/observability metrics, and deploy.
